translations.idiomatic: Yanlang alone rejected the crowd's opinion and asked the Last Emperor to march north—men of insight approved him.

sentences.zh: 晉高祖入洛，送台獄以誅之。

translations.literal: When the Gaozu of Jin entered Luoyang he sent him to the metropolitan prison and executed him.
translations.idiomatic: When the Gaozu of Jin entered Luoyang he sent him to the metropolitan prison and executed him.

sentences.zh: 其後以選求計使，難得其人，甚追悔焉。

translations.literal: Afterward, in selecting and seeking a commissioner of accounts, it was hard to obtain the right man, and he deeply regretted it.
translations.idiomatic: Afterward, in selecting and seeking a commissioner of accounts, it was hard to obtain the right man, and he deeply regretted it.

sentences.zh: 劉延皓，應州渾元人。

translations.literal: Liu Yanhao was a man of Hunyuan in Yingzhou.
translations.idiomatic: Liu Yanhao was a native of Hunyuan in Yingzhou.

sentences.zh: 祖建立，父茂成，皆以軍功推為邊將。

translations.literal: His grandfather Jianli and his father Maocheng were both promoted to frontier generals for military merit.
translations.idiomatic: His grandfather Jianli and his father Maocheng were both promoted to frontier generals for military merit.

sentences.zh: 延皓即劉後之弟也。

translations.literal: Yanhao was the younger brother of Empress Liu.
translations.idiomatic: Yanhao was the younger brother of Empress Liu.

sentences.zh: 末帝鎮鳳翔，署延皓元隨都校，奏加檢校戶部尚書。

translations.literal: When the Last Emperor was posted at Fengxiang he appointed Yanhao commander of his original followers and memorialized to add acting minister of revenue.
translations.idiomatic: When the Last Emperor was posted at Fengxiang he appointed Yanhao commander of his original followers and memorialized to add acting minister of revenue.

sentences.zh: 清泰元年，除宮苑使，加檢校司空。

translations.literal: In the first year of Qingtai he was made palace park commissioner and promoted to acting minister of works.
translations.idiomatic: In the first year of Qingtai he was made palace park commissioner and promoted to acting minister of works.

sentences.zh: 俄改宣徽南院使、檢校司徒。

translations.literal: Soon afterward he was changed to commissioner of the southern bureau of the Palace Domestic Service and acting Grand Mentor.
translations.idiomatic: Soon afterward he was changed to commissioner of the southern bureau of the Palace Domestic Service and acting Grand Mentor.

sentences.zh: 二年，遷樞密使、太保，出為鄴都留守、檢校太傅。

translations.literal: In the second year he was transferred to commissioner of military affairs and Grand Guardian, then sent out as intendant at Ye and acting Grand Tutor.
translations.idiomatic: In the second year he was transferred to commissioner of military affairs and Grand Guardian, then sent out as intendant at Ye and acting Grand Tutor.

sentences.zh: 延皓禦軍失政，為屯將張令昭所逐，出奔相州，尋詔停所任。

translations.literal: Yanhao governed the army badly; the garrison officer Zhang Lingzhao expelled him, he fled to Xiangzhou, and soon an edict stripped him of office.
translations.idiomatic: Yanhao governed the army badly; the garrison officer Zhang Lingzhao expelled him, he fled to Xiangzhou, and soon an edict stripped him of office.

sentences.zh: 及晉高祖入洛，延皓逃匿龍門廣化寺，數日，自經而死。

translations.literal: When the Gaozu of Jin entered Luoyang, Yanhao hid in the Guanghua Temple at Longmen; after several days he hanged himself.
translations.idiomatic: When the Gaozu of Jin entered Luoyang, Yanhao hid in Guanghua Temple at Longmen; after several days he hanged himself.

sentences.zh: 延皓始以後戚自藩邸出入左右，甚以溫厚見稱，故末帝嗣位之後，委居近密。

translations.literal: At first Yanhao, as a maternal relative from the princely household, came and went at the sovereign's side and was greatly praised for his mildness; therefore after the Last Emperor succeeded to the throne he was entrusted with intimate duties.
translations.idiomatic: At first Yanhao, as a maternal relative from the princely household, came and went at the sovereign's side and was greatly praised for his mildness; therefore after the Last Emperor succeeded to the throne he was entrusted with intimate duties.

sentences.zh: 及出鎮大名，而所執一變，掠人財賄，納人園宅，聚歌僮為長夜之飲，而三軍所給不時，內外怨之，因為令昭所逐。

translations.literal: But when he went out to command at Daming his conduct changed entirely: he seized people's wealth as bribes, took their gardens and residences, gathered singing boys for all-night drinking, and paid the three armies' supplies irregularly; inside and outside complained of him, and thereby he was expelled by Lingzhao.
translations.idiomatic: But when he went out to command at Daming his conduct changed entirely: he seized people's wealth as bribes, took their gardens and residences, gathered singing boys for all-night drinking, and paid the three armies' supplies irregularly; inside and outside complained of him, and thereby he was expelled by Lingzhao.

sentences.zh: 時執政以延皓失守，請舉舊章，末帝以劉後內政之故，止從罷免而已，由是清泰之政弊矣。

translations.literal: At the time the chief ministers, because Yanhao had lost his command, asked to apply the old regulations; the Last Emperor, because of Empress Liu's influence in the inner court, only went so far as dismissal—thereby the government of Qingtai was harmed.
translations.idiomatic: At the time the chief ministers, because Yanhao had lost his command, asked to apply the old regulations; the Last Emperor, because of Empress Liu's influence in the inner court, only went so far as dismissal—thereby the government of Qingtai was harmed.

sentences.zh: 劉延朗，宋州虞城人也。

translations.literal: Liu Yanlang was a man of Yucheng in Songzhou.
translations.idiomatic: Liu Yanlang was a native of Yucheng in Songzhou.

sentences.zh: 末帝鎮河中時，為鄆城馬步都虞候，後納為腹心。

translations.literal: When the Last Emperor was posted to Hezhong he was chief inspector of cavalry and infantry at Yancheng; later he was taken in as a trusted confidant.
translations.idiomatic: When the Last Emperor was posted to Hezhong he was chief inspector of cavalry and infantry at Yancheng; later he was taken in as a trusted confidant.

sentences.zh: 及鎮鳳翔，署為孔目吏。

translations.literal: When he was posted to Fengxiang he was appointed a clerical officer.
translations.idiomatic: When he was posted to Fengxiang he was appointed a clerical officer.

sentences.zh: 末帝將圖起義，為捍禦之備，延朗計公私粟帛，以贍其急。

translations.literal: When the Last Emperor was planning to raise an uprising and made preparations for defense, Yanlang calculated public and private grain and cloth to supply the urgent need.
translations.idiomatic: When the Last Emperor was planning to raise an uprising and made preparations for defense, Yanlang calculated public and private grain and cloth to supply the urgent need.

sentences.zh: 及西師納降，末帝赴洛，皆無所闕焉，末帝甚賞之。

translations.literal: When the western army submitted and the Last Emperor went to Luoyang, nothing was lacking in any respect, and the Last Emperor greatly rewarded him.
translations.idiomatic: When the western army submitted and the Last Emperor went to Luoyang, nothing was lacking in any respect, and the Last Emperor greatly rewarded him.

sentences.zh: 清泰初，除宣徽北院使，俄以劉延皓守鄴，改副樞密使，累官至檢校太傅。

translations.literal: At the beginning of Qingtai he was made commissioner of the northern bureau of the Palace Domestic Service; soon, because Liu Yanhao was intendant at Ye, he was changed to deputy commissioner of military affairs and rose in succession to acting Grand Tutor.
translations.idiomatic: At the beginning of Qingtai he was made commissioner of the northern bureau of the Palace Domestic Service; soon, because Liu Yanhao was intendant at Ye, he was changed to deputy commissioner of military affairs and rose in succession to acting Grand Tutor.

sentences.zh: 時房皓為樞密使，但高枕閑眠，啟奏除授，一歸延朗，由是得志。

translations.literal: At that time Fang Hao was commissioner of military affairs but only rested his head high and slept at leisure; memorials for appointments and dismissals all went to Yanlang, and thereby he got his way.
translations.idiomatic: At that time Fang Hao was commissioner of military affairs but only rested his head high and slept at leisure; memorials for appointments and dismissals all went to Yanlang, and thereby he got his way.

sentences.zh: 凡藩侯郡牧，自外入者，必先賂延朗，後議進貢，賂厚者先居內地，賂薄者晚出邊藩，故諸將屢有怨訕，末帝不能察之。

translations.literal: Whenever frontier lords and prefects came in from outside, they had first to bribe Yanlang and only afterward discuss advancing tribute; those who bribed heavily were first placed in inner territories, those who bribed lightly were sent out late to border commands—therefore the generals often had resentful complaints, which the Last Emperor could not perceive.
translations.idiomatic: Whenever frontier lords and prefects came in from outside, they had first to bribe Yanlang and only afterward discuss advancing tribute; those who bribed heavily were first placed in inner territories, those who bribed lightly were sent out late to border commands—therefore the generals often had resentful complaints, which the Last Emperor could not perceive.

sentences.zh: 及晉高祖入洛，延朗將竄於南山，與從者數輩，過其私第，指而歎曰：「我有錢三十萬貫聚於此，不知為何人所得。」

translations.literal: When the Gaozu of Jin entered Luoyang, Yanlang was about to flee into the southern mountains; with several followers he passed his private residence, pointed at it, and sighed, "I have three hundred thousand strings of cash gathered here—I do not know who will obtain it."
translations.idiomatic: When the Gaozu of Jin entered Luoyang, Yanlang was about to flee into the southern mountains; with several followers he passed his private residence, pointed at it, and sighed, "I have three hundred thousand strings of cash gathered here—I do not know who will obtain it."

sentences.zh: 其愚暗如此。

translations.literal: His foolish darkness was such as this.
translations.idiomatic: His foolish darkness was such as this.

sentences.zh: 尋捕而殺之。

translations.literal: Soon he was captured and killed.
translations.idiomatic: Soon he was captured and killed.
